name: Sarah Mitchell
title: Engineering Manager
summary: Engineering leader with 9+ years of experience building and scaling software teams in fast-paced product environments. Strong track record of improving delivery predictability, coaching engineers, and partnering with product and design to ship reliable customer-facing platforms.

bullets: Lead a team of 8 engineers across checkout infrastructure, improving deployment frequency by 35% while reducing production incidents by 28%.
Partner with product and design to deliver 4 major roadmap initiatives per quarter, consistently meeting 90%+ of committed milestones.
Implemented a performance and coaching framework that increased internal promotion readiness for 3 engineers within 12 months.
Managed 2 squads totalling 12 engineers delivering digital banking features used by more than 1.5M monthly active users.
Drove modernization of legacy release processes, cutting release cycle time from 3 weeks to 5 days.
Led hiring and onboarding efforts that improved team capacity by 25% and reduced new-hire ramp-up time by 30%.
Built and scaled a Toronto engineering pod from 4 to 10 engineers, supporting a 2x increase in product throughput.
Established measurable sprint planning and engineering health metrics, improving on-time delivery from 68% to 88%.
Collaborated with platform teams to introduce service ownership practices that lowered mean time to recovery by 40%.
Led a team modernization initiative for claims workflow systems, reducing manual processing steps by 20% and improving customer turnaround time.
Coordinated architecture decisions across development, QA, and operations to support a cloud migration program affecting 6 applications.
Mentored 5 developers through code reviews and technical pairing, contributing to higher code quality and fewer escaped defects.

education.degree: Bachelor of Applied Science in Computer Engineering
